description.value:
Swamp of the Underworld. The ground in a 30-foot burst within range converts into a sucking morass that lasts for 10 minutes.

Creatures in the area when the swamp forms must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure they are immobilized as they sink to their waist; on a critical failure they sink fully and begin drowning at the end of their next turn unless they Escape (DC = your spell DC).

The area becomes greater difficult terrain for everyone (1 square of movement costs 4 feet). Creatures Larger than Medium take 1 less penalty per size category.

The jutsu requires a 30-foot patch of natural earth; it cannot form over stone, ice, or open water.

system.requirements: natural earth in the targeted area
